No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. Image 1 is the dining room seen from across the table, looking straight at the side wall with the framed family photos and the china hutch: the shot takes place in exactly this room, same furniture, same light; keep the background exactly as in Image 1. Image 2 is her son's character sheet: use it only for his face, skin tone, haircut, beard and clothes. Image 3 is the granddaughter's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, braids, earrings and clothes. Image 4 shows this birthday dinner from the main camera at the foot of the table: use it only to know who sits in which chair and how the aunt and the uncle look and dress; this shot looks from the other side of the table, as in Image 1. Medium shot. The photo shows a medium shot from across the birthday table: the son stands at his chair raising his drinking glass toward his mother at the head of the table, just out of the frame at screen-right; behind him, soft, the framed family photos on the side wall; the sideboard is out of the frame, on the side he looks toward; beside him at screen-left, soft, his daughter, still chewing, her fork in her hand; beyond her at screen-left the aunt lifts her drinking glass toward the head of the table. Her son: a 46-year-old Black American man with deep brown skin, a low taper fade with a little grey at the temples, a neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper beard, a tense jaw and a gold wedding band. He wears a navy quarter-zip pullover and chinos. The granddaughter: a 19-year-old Black American woman with medium brown skin, long knotless braids gathered in a low ponytail, small gold hoop earrings and a bright, expressive face. She wears a plain grey hoodie with no logo and leggings. From this side of the table the head of the table is at screen-right: along the side wall, from screen-right to screen-left, sit her son, then the granddaughter, then the aunt. The aunt, the grandmother's younger sister, about 66: a Black American woman with medium-brown skin, a round face and shoulder-length silver-grey natural hair in soft twists; she wears a plum-colored dress. This shot shows only part of the dinner: everyone not described here is out of the frame, and nobody else is in the room. Other dishes on the table, soft: collard greens, candied sweet potatoes and cornbread. No birthday cake on the table yet. Expressions true to this moment: the son proud and warm, smiling at his mother as he toasts; his daughter chewing with a strained, uneasy face, trying not to show it; the aunt smiling, her glass raised; natural and believable, never exaggerated or posed. Every hand has five fingers in natural proportion and a natural grip; each person has exactly two arms and two hands; nothing floats. Everyone's eyes stay off-lens; nobody looks into the camera. Look: warm evening light from a small chandelier, soft shadows, warm family-film color. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Brown skin true to life: each person keeps their own skin depth and undertone, with soft natural highlights and visible detail in the shadows; palms lighter than the backs of the hands; never grey, ashy or lightened. Final check: her son is the same man as in his character sheet, with the same skin tone, haircut and beard; the granddaughter is the same young woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone and braids.
